sync.intro: Sync the working tree of “{{name}}” (including uncommitted files) and its UI state through your Orkestr gateway. Everything is end-to-end encrypted; the server only stores ciphertext. Git history is never touched.
sync.noProject: Open a project to configure sync.
sync.noRoot: This project is not bound to a folder, so there is nothing to sync.
sync.policyDenied: The project’s privacy policy forbids remote sync.
sync.unavailable: Sync is not available in this build of the core yet.
sync.remoteKeyHint: Leave empty on the first device to generate one; paste the same key on your other devices.
sync.remoteProjectHint: Must be the same on every device. Defaults to the project slug.
sync.generatedKey: New remote key — copy it to your other devices now, it is shown only once:
sync.continueHint: Publishes the working tree, open editors and a task summary so another device can pick up.
